title: Bennie Moten's band splits and Thamon Hayes forms the Rockets
summary: After the Moten band split, Thamon Hayes took half and formed what became the Kansas City Rockets; Dickenson left for Cincinnati and Clarence Page.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: He capped everybody with that -- that'd do it you know. So the guys who were in London came. And they -- there was -- they had some kind of a thing going on where the guys were fighting each other or something. You know -- disagreeing -- in the Bennie Moten (PHONETIC) band. So they -- they split. Half of them went one way and half went the other. The one that went -- that wasn't -- that didn't stay with Bennie -- was Kevin Hayes (PHONETIC), he took the band. There was Kevin Hayes (PHONETIC) and we stayed together for a little while. That band later turned out to be the Rockets (PHONETIC). Kansas City Rockets (PHONETIC).
Yeah. Harlan was in the band but he wasn't -- he didn't have it to run his band at the first time -- you know.

Yeah, Damon Hayes (PHONETIC). And so we -- I was -- and I left the band and come back to Cincinnati, and stayed with them -- well Chris had a guy to get the band together. His name was Clarence Page (PHONETIC). So I played with Clarence Page. He just died incidentally about two months ago now.
